reviewedEventExclusions.boundaryBasis: Independent primary-source review accepts this distinct Q3 results publication. November 4 advisory and release calendar schedule November 10; November 10 release says issued today. An unexplained CMD calendar lists November 3. The conservative November 3 boundary accommodates that discrepancy: it is a reviewed timing inference, not proof against every possible earlier disclosure. Older HELOC trend background is not this event.
reviewedEventExclusions.copyLead: New York Fed Q3 2026 data show HELOC balances rose $23 billion to $481 billion, their largest quarterly increase since 2005. For credit-union lending teams, the useful comparison is product-specific demand and credit risk. The separate $257 billion mortgage-balance rise needs care: roughly half reflects re-reporting. These are national household-credit figures, not credit-union results.
reviewedEventExclusions.scope: One exact reviewed underlying event and body/copy. All retained historical flags stay unchanged. Any active, new or missing provider record invalidates the exception. Existing publisher must accept the exact released proof and qualify this Standard selection; no reservation or post is created here.
